A friendlier CastleParcel: the whole trip now happens on one page under the castle, in 42 languages.

## ✨ Added

- 16 new languages: Bulgarian, Catalan, Estonian, Basque, Persian, Galician, Hindi, Croatian, Indonesian, Icelandic, Lithuanian, Latvian, Malay, Slovak, Slovenian and Serbian. CastleParcel now speaks 42.
- Back and Forward move between the options, the upload, the link, a note, a request and the settings, from the browser or from a mouse's side buttons. Going back during an upload asks before it stops.
- The App tab in the settings lists MOS, ZimaOS and Umbrel next to Unraid and Docker.

## 🎨 Design

- One page for the whole trip: choosing files, writing a note or opening a request slides the castle up and opens the form right under it, and the upload and the link show up there too. The share page a recipient opens is built the same way.
- The castle turns into the transfer animation in place, at exactly its size, and back into the logo once the transfer is done.
- The letters fly in from the edge of the window and out past it.
- The gate stays as dark as the logo's and lights up only while a letter passes through it.
- The glow behind the castle shows only under the pointer or while files are dragged over the page.
- New start page lines: "Into the castle it goes. Only the recipient gets in." and "Pinky promise, encrypted with maths."

## ⚡ Improved

- Confirm dialogs offer Back instead of a second Cancel, the management row says it also deletes the files, and an empty file list says there are no files in it yet.
- The settings no longer show placeholders for a phone app.
- Built on GlimStone 4.3.4.

## 🌐 Translations

- All 42 languages carry the new start page lines and every new text.
